title: Rabbi Chiyya son of Rav Yitzchak Atushya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: His father was a student of Rabbi Zeira, as in Jerusalem Talmud Peah, chapter 8, end of halakhah 4. He lived in Rabbi Yirmeyah’s time, as in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1: in the days of Rabbi Yirmeyah, distress came upon the people of Tiberias; Rabbi Yirmeyah sent asking for a silver candelabrum from Rabbi Yaakov bar Bun … and Rabbi Yaakov wished to excommunicate Rabbi Yirmeyah, but Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Yitzchak Atushya did not let him. In Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan, chapter 3, beginning of halakhah 5, and Nazir 3:1, Rabbi Yirmeyah instructed Rabbi Yitzchak Atushya. In Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:6, Rabbi Zeira (II) went up to visit Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Yitzchak Atushya.
Hyman says Yuchasin confused him with Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yitzchak.

notes.text: Saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1 makes Rabbi Yirmeyah the sender and Rabbi Yaakov bar Bun the person seeking to excommunicate him. Rabbi Chiyya intervenes; plural they/them is corrected. The supplied full title Rav Yitzchak in the heading and Rabbi Yitzchak in the named witness remain distinct, as do the second-Zeira identification and Yuchasin criticism.

The complete Guggenheimer Moed Katan 3:1 paragraph has Yirmeyah sending for the silver candelabrum, Yaakov bar Bun seeking excommunication, and Chiyya son of Rabbi Yitzchak Atushya intervening; its later mutual excommunications are outside Hyman’s excerpt. The supplied Rav/Rabbi titles, Zeira-II assignment and Yuchasin criticism remain distinguished.
